propositions: LLMConfig must expose a headers field resolvable from three-layer precedence (CLI > env > file) with hard errors on malformed JSON in every layer.

Header placeholder grammar supports ${env:VAR} (resolved at config time, unset raises error), ${run:KEY} (unresolved, KEY validated against closed vocabulary), and $$ (escapes to literal $); unrecognized namespaces, missing colons, unclosed placeholders, and unknown ${run:...} keys raise LLMConfigError.

Validation runs after ${env:...} substitution to prevent control-character injection; header names in the denylist (authorization, x-api-key, cookie, host, proxy-authorization) are rejected case-insensitively with error message directing to llm.api_key field.
File-layer headers field accepts native TOML table or JSON string; malformed JSON string, non-string/non-table values, or JSON parsing to non-object raise LLMConfigError naming the layer.

No unconfigured deployment changes (headers defaults to {}); no gateway-vendor header constants (x-litellm-, helicone-, case-insensitive) exist under src/rebar/llm/ to avoid hardcoding vendor-specific denylist.
